entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: An information element that may be included to assign a new CAG information list to the UE or delete the CAG information list at the UE side.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives and processes the CAG information list IE.

entities.name: Assign CAG information list
entities.description: Condition where a new CAG information list is provided to the UE.

entities.name: Delete CAG information list
entities.description: Condition where the CAG information list is removed from the UE.

relations.description: The CAG information list IE can trigger assignment of a new CAG list to the UE.
The CAG information list IE can trigger deletion of the CAG list at the UE.
Assigning a new CAG information list establishes the updated list at the UE.
Deleting the CAG information list establishes the removal of the list at the UE.
